summary: Applying a magic whistle with a tame dog reaches apply.c:use_magic_whistle and its magic_whistled pet-relocation loop. JavaScript doapply lacks the MAGIC_WHISTLE arm and refuses before the source-ordered teleport.c:collect_coords draws. Port the complete magic-whistle family and both doapply instrument paths; preserve the distinction between ordinary and cursed magic outcomes.

source.branch: doapply selects MAGIC_WHISTLE and calls use_magic_whistle. With a noncursed whistle and a hero who can blow, it prints the strange whistle line and calls magic_whistled; each live tame non-steed monster can be moved beside the hero through mnexto and observed or discovered depending on prior visibility. Cursed whistles can instead hum, wake nearby monsters, and conditionally teleport a pet.
callers: C apply.c:doapply MAGIC_WHISTLE arm calls use_magic_whistle; its blessed EUCALYPTUS_LEAF arm also calls that function before a possible blessing wear-off draw. JS js/apply.js:doapply currently lacks the MAGIC_WHISTLE arm and raises UnsupportedApplyError.

JS mnexto currently has an ignored _rlocflags parameter, so verify its RLOC_MSG/RLOC_NONE behavior and relocation messages against the source.
The magic_whistled loop consumes trap.c:mintrap result after relocation; JS mintrap is present but may refuse unported trap effects. Keep its active return branches and luck/message ordering.
Soundeffect is silent under the recorder nosound backend. C discover_object via makeknown occurs only after visible pet relocation on a previously unknown whistle; preserve that state transition.
